types.label: Assessment Report
types.description: Structure, question profile, coverage, similarity findings and recommendations for one assessment or version.

types.label: Assessment Quality Report
types.description: STEP 13 quality dimensions and ratings; aggregated counts at course, faculty, department or institution scope.

types.label: Assessment Blueprint Report
types.description: Blueprint targets, validation status and target-vs-actual comparison with the question set.

types.label: Assessment Version History
types.description: Every version of an assessment with status, approvals, change summaries and version-to-version differences.

types.label: Question Analysis Report
types.description: Question-level marks, difficulty, cognitive level, outcome mapping and analysis findings.

types.label: CO/LO Coverage Report
types.description: Learning-outcome coverage evidence: strong, weak and non-aligned questions per outcome.

types.label: PO Coverage Report
types.description: Program-outcome evidence from the current CO/PO analysis, where a program is configured.

types.label: Student Performance Report
types.description: Aggregated performance from finalized faculty grades: averages, distribution, question, topic and outcome performance.

types.label: Learning Gap Report
types.description: STEP 30 gap classification per outcome and topic against the configured benchmark.

types.label: Rubric Report
types.description: Rubrics, criteria, maximum marks and scoring guidance per question.

types.label: Grading Report
types.description: Aggregated finalized grades per question with the share of AI-assisted versus faculty-only grading.

types.label: Inter-Grader Consistency Report
types.description: FacultyLens Agreement Indicator across graders, where multi-grader data exists.

types.label: AI Evaluation Report
types.description: Model, prompt and dataset versions with evaluated metrics per task and run.

types.label: Academic Analytics Report
types.description: Export of the STEP 36 analytics overview: KPIs, quality, coverage, performance, gaps, rubrics, grading and AI evaluation.
